description: `// swift-tools-version`, Go `//go:` and `//nolint`, `// swiftlint:`, `// eslint-disable` and `// eslint-enable`, `// prettier-ignore`, `/// <reference`, and a short `// MARK:` label count as directives. Today they trigger what_comment, prose_colon, and prose_comment_block, so Package.swift cannot be written. The `///` doc prefix is stripped fully. The JS test at hooks/test_hooks.py:244 uses `#` and moves to `//`.
title: Tool directive comments pass the comment rules
